title: Ranghar Taunts Turn the Morinda March into Battle

blocks.text: The rooftop abuse now sharpens into sacrilege and challenge. The Ranghars mock the Sikhs with references to the Sahibzadas, boast about earlier cruelty, and openly dare the Khalsa to stop and fight instead of marching on.

When the Sikh side answers back, the Ranghars opened a volley of fire and the quarrel crosses the line into bloodshed. A shot hit one of Tara Singh's Singhs, making it impossible to treat the exchange as mere abuse.

News of the firing races through the marching force and turns outrage into mobilization. By the end of the page the war drum is beaten and Morinda is no longer a place to bypass, but a target that must be punished.
